item.title: General Rezaei: Any evil act against Iran will bring affliction on US to be recorded in history

item.title: Araghchi’s message of appreciation to President Pezeshkian: Diplomacy is at forefront of defending Iran
item.description: Tehran, IRNA – Following the selection of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs as the "Outstanding Agency" in the "Yavar-e Fath" (Supporter of Victory) category of the 21st Shahid Rajaei Festival, Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi issued a message to President Masoud Pezeshkian expressing appreciation for the support and confidence shown by him and the government toward the Ministry.
